source: Otero et al. 2015, Zoological Journal of the Linnean Society 174: 589-634, Fig. 19: simplified reduced consensus tree with calibrated phylogeny of sauropodiforms; a vertical rectangular tree with the root at the bottom, rotated italic tip names above each tip line, a stage and period column at the left over coloured stage bands, continent silhouettes above the tips, an arrow for Eusauropoda, a question mark under Sefapanosaurus and clade names with leader lines. Image: census figure (1333x672 px).
names_note: no matrix held; list = the printed tip names ('basalmost sauropodomorphs' as printed)
gold_note: Time-calibrated sauropodiform tree, 19 tips, fully resolved; a pectinate ladder read from right-angle node bars (the image rotated to put the root on the left and node lines listed per column). Eusauropoda is an arrow tip. Random-sample case (seed 20261106); topology only.
